IMDb says third parties include analytics, ad network and advertising companies and points to Amazon's interest-based ads policy.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 9.3.5.109350300 (report dated Sept. 4, 2026) found code signatures for 8 known tracker SDK(s): Amazon Advertisement, Amazon Analytics (Amazon insights) (analytics), Branch (analytics), ComScore (analytics advertisement), Google AdMob (advertisement), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), IAB Open Measurement (identification advertisement), JW Player. A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
